αἰδοίως: αἰδοῖος — held in respect; adv. αἰδοίως: ’with respect, reverently’
αἴσῃ: αἶσα — portion, lot, fate; fem. dat. sg., Ionic and Attic alike (the η follows σ); κακῇ αἴσῃ ’by an evil fate’
αὐλοῖσιν: αὐλός — pipe, tube; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οῖς); of a brooch, apparently the sheaths for the pin
γυρὸς: γυρός — rounded, bent, hunched; masc. nom. sg.: ’round-shouldered’
γόου: γόος — wailing, lament; masc. gen. sg., + παῦσαι: ’from lament’
δίπλακα: δίπλαξ — double cloak, a mantle folded double; fem. acc. sg. (δίπλαξ, δίπλακος)
δαίδαλον: δαίδαλος — cunningly wrought; neut. nom. sg. (as a noun δαίδαλον ’a work of art’)
διδύμοισι: δίδυμος — double, twin; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
διπλῆν: διπλόος (Attic διπλοῦς) — double, folded double; fem. acc. sg., contracted from διπλόην (as in Attic)
εἵπετο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 sg., with augment εἵ- (= ἐ- + ἕπετο)
εὐρυβάτης: Εὐρυβάτης — Eurybates, Odysseus’ herald (’wide-strider’); masc. nom. sg.
θαυμάζεσκον: θαυμάζω — wonder at, marvel at; impf. 3 pl., iterative -εσκον, unaugmented (= Attic ἐθαύμαζον): ’used to marvel’
θρινακίης: Θρινακίη — Thrinacia, the island of the Sun’s cattle; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας)
κέρα: κέρας — horn; neut. pl. κέρα (epic, beside Attic κέρατα), of horn as a material: ’horn’
κακοΐλιον: Κακοΐλιος — ’Evil Ilium’, ill-omened Troy (κακός + Ἴλιος); fem. acc. sg.
κατέτηξεν: κατατήκω — melt down, dissolve; aor. 3 sg. act., transitive: ’melted’
κατατήκετ: κατατήκομαι — melt away, dissolve; pres. 3 sg. mid./pass., elided (κατατήκετ’ = κατατήκεται)
καταχεύῃ: καταχέω — pour down; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic stem χευ- (Attic aor. κατέχεα, subj. καταχέῃ), in a clause with ἐπήν
κεῦθεν: κεύθω — hide, conceal; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔκευθεν): ’kept hidden’
κλαιούσης: κλαίω — weep, lament; pres. part. fem. gen. sg.: ’weeping’
κουρίδιον: κουρίδιος — wedded, lawful (of a husband or wife); masc. acc. sg.
κρομύοιο: κρόμυον — onion; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
λάε: λάω — grip, seize; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔλαε); sense disputed, also taken as ’gaze at’
λάων: λάω — grip, seize; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. (sense disputed, also taken as ’gazing at’)
λαμπρὸς: λαμπρός — bright, shining; masc. nom. sg.
λοπὸν: λοπός — peel, skin (of an onion); masc. acc. sg.
μαλακός: μαλακός — soft, tender; masc. nom. sg.
μελανόχροος: μελανόχρους — dark-skinned, swarthy; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted -όχροος (= Attic -όχρους)
μεμαὼς: μέμαα (μάω) — strive, be eager; perf. part. masc. nom. sg., epic, with present sense (no Attic equivalent): ’straining, eager’
ξείνισας: ξεινίζω — entertain as a guest; aor. 2 sg., Ionic ξειν- (= Attic ξενίζω, ἐξένισας), unaugmented: ’you entertained’
ξεῖνέ: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. voc. sg., accented before the enclitic γε
οἴκοθ: οἴκοθεν — from home, from one’s house; adv., elided (οἴκοθ’ = οἴκοθεν), with -θεν ’from’
οὐλοκάρηνος: οὐλοκάρηνος — woolly-headed, curly-haired (οὖλος ’thick, woolly’ + κάρη ’head’); masc. nom. sg.
οὔλην: οὖλος — thick, woolly (of a cloak); fem. acc. sg., not the homograph οὖλος ’destructive’
παρήϊα: παρήϊον — cheek; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic -ήϊα (= Attic παρειά, pl. παρειαί)
παῦσαι: παύω — make stop; mid. cease, leave off (+ gen.); aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’cease!’
πειρήσεσθαι: πειράω — try, test (+ gen.); fut. inf. mid., Ionic η (= Attic πειράσεσθαι): ’to put to the test’
περόνη: περόνη — brooch, pin for fastening a garment; fem. nom. sg. (same in Attic)
περόνην: περόνη — brooch, pin for fastening a garment; fem. acc. sg. (same in Attic)
πλήθουσι: πλήθω — be full, swell, overflow; pres. 3 pl.: ’are full’
πολλαί: πολύς — much, many; fem. nom. pl.: ’many’
πολυδακρύτοιο: πολυδάκρυτος — much-wept, tearful; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), + gen. after τάρφθη
προτέροισι: πρότερος — former, fore; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις): πρότεροι πόδες ’forefeet’
πτύξασ: πτύσσω — fold; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., elided (πτύξασ’ = πτύξασα): ’having folded’
σήματ: σῆμα — sign, token, mark; neut. acc. pl., elided (σήματ’ = σήματα)
σόος: σόος (Attic σῶς) — safe, sound; masc. nom. sg., epic uncontracted
τάρφθη: τέρπω — delight, satisfy; aor. pass. 3 sg., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτέρφθη), + gen.: ’took her fill of’
τέκῃ: τίκτω — bear, give birth to; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., in a general relative clause without κε (= Attic τέκῃ with ἄν)
τερμιόεντα: τερμιόεις — with a border or fringe (τέρμα ’end, edge’; exact sense uncertain); masc. acc. sg.
τηκομένης: τήκω — melt; mid./pass. pres. part. fem. gen. sg.: ’melting’
τιμήσαντο: τιμάω — honor; aor. 3 pl. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐτιμήσαντο): ’they honored’
τῆκε: τήκω — melt, waste; pres. imper. act. 2 sg., transitive: ’melt away (your heart)’
φαεινὴν: φαεινός — bright, shining; fem. acc. sg. (epic by-form of φανός)
χάλκειον: χάλκειος (Attic χάλκεος) — of bronze; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic χαλκοῦν)
χεούσης: χέω — pour, shed; pres. part. fem. gen. sg.: ’shedding’
χιτῶν: χιτών — tunic; masc. acc. sg., elided (χιτῶν’ = χιτῶνα)
χρύσεοι: χρύσεος — golden, of gold; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic χρυσοῖ)
ἀγυρτάζειν: ἀγυρτάζω — collect by begging, beg together; pres. inf. act.: ’to beg up’
ἀκουούσης: ἀκούω — hear, listen; pres. part. act. fem. gen. sg. (same in Attic)
ἀκροπόλοισιν: ἀκρόπολος — high-peaked, lofty; dat. pl. in -οισιν, the same in all genders (= Attic -οις), of mountains
ἀλλοῖον: ἀλλοῖος — of another sort, different; masc. acc. sg.: ’another kind of (man)’
ἀναγνούσῃ: ἀναγιγνώσκω — know again, recognize; aor. part. fem. dat. sg. (ἀναγνούς, ἀναγνοῦσα)
ἀπάγχων: ἀπάγχω — throttle, strangle; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.
ἀπέπεμπον: ἀποπέμπω — send away, send off; impf. 1 sg. (form also 3 pl.): ’I sent off’
ἀπήμαντον: ἀπήμαντος — unharmed, without hurt; masc. acc. sg.
ἀπελήλυθε: ἀπέρχομαι — go away, depart; perf. 3 sg. (perf. ἀπελήλυθα): ’has gone away’
ἀπεσσεῖται: ἄπειμι — be away, be absent; fut. 3 sg., epic -σσ-, ending -εῖται (= Attic ἀπέσται)
ἄγαλμ: ἄγαλμα — delight, ornament, keepsake; neut. nom./acc. sg., elided (ἄγαλμ’ = ἄγαλμα)
ἄσσα: τις, τι — some, any; indef. pron., neut. nom./acc. pl., epic ἄσσα (= Attic τινά), after ὁπποῖα: ’of what sort’
ἐεικοστὸν: εἰκοστός — twentieth; neut. nom. sg., epic ἐεικοστός (= Attic εἰκοστόν)
ἐλεεινός: ἐλεεινός — pitiable, piteous; masc. nom. sg.
ἐλλόν: ἐλλός — fawn, young deer; masc. acc. sg.
ἐναίρεο: ἐναίρω — kill, destroy, ruin; pres. imper. mid. 2 sg., epic -εο (= Attic ἐναίρου): ’destroy!’
ἐπέθηκα: ἐπιτίθημι — put on, place upon; aor. 1 sg. act.: ’I put on’
ἐποψόμενος: ἐφοράω — look upon, visit; fut. part. mid. masc. nom. sg., epic ἐπόψομαι, of purpose: ’to look upon’
ἐτεὸν: ἐτεός — true, real; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’truly, in truth’
ἐτύμοισιν: ἔτυμος — true, real; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις): ’true things’
ἔσῃ: εἰμί — be; fut. 2 sg.: ’you will be’
ἤην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἤσπαιρε: ἀσπαίρω — gasp, quiver, struggle; impf. 3 sg., augmented: ’struggled’
ἰσχαλέοιο: ἰσχαλέος — dry, dried; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), with κρομύοιο
ἴσκε: ἴσκω — make like, liken, represent as; impf. 3 sg.: ’made (lies) like (true things)’
ὀδύσαντο: ὀδύσσομαι — be angry with, hate (+ dat.); aor. 3 pl. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ὠδύσαντο)
ὀλέσασα: ὄλλυμι — destroy; aor. part. act. fem. nom. sg., with an object: ’having lost’
ὀνομαστήν: ὀνομαστός — to be named, nameable, famous; fem. acc. sg., with οὐκ: ’not to be named’
ὁπποῖ: ὁποῖος (epic ὁπποῖος) — of what sort; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὁπποῖ’ = ὁπποῖα), in an indirect question
ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια δοῦναι ’give oaths, swear’
ὕπατος: ὕπατος — highest, supreme; masc. nom. sg. (superlative form, ὕπερ)
ὤμνυε: ὄμνυμι — swear; impf. 3 sg. act., augmented: ’swore, was swearing’
ῥέοντες: ῥέω — flow; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’flowing’

__broaden__.αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο) · also reflexive intensive gen. sg. after a personal pronoun: σέο τ’ αὐτοῦ ’and of yourself’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’from it’, after ἐκ (ἐκ δ’ αὐτοῦ πείρατ’ ἀνήφθω, of the mast) · also masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive sense, ’his own’: αὐτοῦ ἐνεύναιον ’his own bedding’, αὐτοῦ βώτορες ’his own herdsmen’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun with a noun, ’his’: ὀστέα δ’ αὐτοῦ ’and his bones’ · also intensive gen. sg. with a demonstrative and noun: τοῦδ’ αὐτοῦ λυκάβαντος ’this very year’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun of a thing, ’upon it’, after ἐπί (ἐπ’ αὐτοῦ, of a stool) · also gen. sg. pronoun of comparison after a comparative: ’than he’ (προγενέστερος αὐτοῦ ’older than he’)
__broaden__.αὐτὸν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’him(self)’ · also reinforcing σε: ’you yourself’ (σ’ αὐτὸν) · also acc. sg. reinforcing an unexpressed 1st-person pronoun: ’me myself’ (αὐτὸν δ’ ἐνθάδ’ ἔχουσα ’keeping me myself here’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, after a preposition: ἀμφ’ αὐτὸν ’around him’ · also plain acc. sg. pronoun of a thing, unemphatic ’it’ (masc. χιτών), as direct object of a verb: ἐθηήσαντο αὐτὸν ’gazed at it’
__broaden__.εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’ · also with opt., in a wish: ’if only’ (εἰ … ὁμοφρονέοις … γένοιο) · also ὡς εἰ + opt., ’as if’ (ὡς εἰ … ἱκοίατο ’as if they had come’) · also ὡς εἰ, ’as if’, before a noun with no verb of its own (ὡς εἰ κέρα … ἠὲ σίδηρος ’as if horn or iron’)
__broaden__.ἠέλιος: ἥλιος (epic ἠέλιος) — sun; nom. sg. · also Ἠέλιος, the Sun as a god, Helios: nom. sg.
__broaden__.ἐναλίγκιον: ἐναλίγκιος — like, resembling (+ dat.); masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the speaker: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the object ἄνακτα: ’like (a beggar)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with the relative ὅν (subject of εἶναι), + dat.: ’like (the gods)’ (θεοῖς ἐναλίγκιον)
__broaden__.ὀλίγον: ὀλίγος — small, little, slight; masc. acc. sg. or neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a little’ (ὀλίγον προγενέστερος ’a little older’)
__broaden__.τρόπιος: τρόπις — keel; fem. gen. sg., governed by περί: ’around, astride the keel’ · also gen. of separation with a verb of loosing: ’from the keel’ · also gen. sg. governed by ἐπί, ’upon the keel’
__broaden__.οἷόν: οἷος — such as, of what sort; masc. acc. sg. correlative with τοῖος (τοῖος ἐὼν οἷόν μιν ’just such as when’) · also neut. acc. sg., adverbial and consecutive: ’so that, such that’ (οἷόν σ’ … οὐδέ σε πείθω) · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially, + τε: ’such as, like’ (οἷόν τε κρομύοιο λοπὸν κάτα ’such as is along the skin of an onion’)
__broaden__.οὐδέν: οὐδείς, οὐδεμία, οὐδέν — no one, nothing; neut. acc. sg.: ’nothing, no (word)’ · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’not at all’ (νεμεσσῶμαί … οὐδέν ’I feel no indignation at all’)
__broaden__.ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’) · also ὥς ’just as’, in ὥς περ (accented before enclitic περ) (ὥς περ ὑπέστης ’just as you promised’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic με (ὥς με κελεύεις ’as you bid me’) · also postpositive after its noun, comparative ’like’ (οἰωνῶν ὥς ’like birds’) · also ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τοι (ὥς τοι ἐγὼν ἐρέω ’as I shall tell you’) · also correlative ’so’ answering ὅπως, introducing a wish with the opt., accented before the enclitic τοι: ’so may’ (ὥς τοι Ζεὺς τελέσειεν ’so may Zeus fulfil it for you’) · also with a plain subj. (no κε/ἄν), purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς τοι δῶρ’ ἀποπέμψω ’so that I may send you the gifts’) · also ὥς accented before enclitic οἱ, of measure: ’as much as’ (ὥς οἱ χεῖρες ἐχάνδανον ’as much as his hands could hold’) · also exclamatory, ’how’, accented before the enclitic τις (ὥς τις θαρσαλέος … ἐσσι ’how bold you are’) · also with the plain optative (no κε/ἄν), purpose, accented before the enclitic μιν: ’so that’ (ὥς μιν ψυχὴ λίποι ’so that life should leave him’) · also ὡς ’as, how’, accented before enclitic μοι (ὥς μοι ἰνδάλλεται ’as it seems to me’)
__broaden__.ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’ · also ’before’ after a verb of anticipating (ἔφθης … ἢ ἐγώ ’you got here before I did’) · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἔτι … ἦέ τις ’whether still … or someone’) · also ’than’ after a verb of preferring: βουλοίμην … ἢ … ἀνάσσειν ’I would rather … than rule’ · also introducing the first alternative of a deliberation: ’whether … or’ (ἢ ἐλάσει’ … ἦέ μιν ἦκ’ ἐλάσειε) · also ’than’ after a word of difference (ἀλλοῖον … ἢ Ὀδυσῆ’ ’another … than Odysseus’)
__broaden__.πάρος: πάρος — before, formerly; adv., with inf. like Attic πρίν · also a plain temporal adverb with a finite verb, not paired with an infinitive: ’formerly, in the past’ (αἳ πάρος ἦσαν ’who formerly were’) · also ’before (that)’ with a finite verb, in the past: πάρος δ’ εἰς Ἴλιον ᾤχετο ’before that he went to Ilios’ · also with a participle: ’formerly, before’ (πάρος περ ἐὼν ’though formerly being’)
